name: pandoralm
description: Enterprise-grade Hybrid RAG platform with Hub-and-Spoke microservices architecture
author: PandoraLM Team

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm setup:envs && pnpm prisma:setup
scripts.setup:envs: cp -n ./core/frontend/.env.example ./core/frontend/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n ./core/server/.env.example ./core/server/.env.development 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n ./core/collector/.env.example ./core/collector/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n ./infra/docker/.env.example ./infra/docker/.env 2>/dev/null || true && echo 'ENV files ready'
scripts.dev:cortex: cd cortex && poetry run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd core/server && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:seed: cd core/server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:setup: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm prisma:migrate && pnpm prisma:seed
